title: DISE Caption-to-Category Matrix Builder + Coverage Checker
description: Builds a trial-balance-caption-to-DISE-natural-expense-category crosswalk for ASC 280 disaggregation of income statement expenses (ASU 2023-07). Computes a coverage matrix (caption x category), flags unmapped captions explicitly, and an optional dollar coverage percentage when balances are supplied.

captions.description: Entity income statement captions, each optionally carrying a total balance

mappings.description: TB caption to DISE category mapping rows

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_dise_caption_category_matrix
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds a coverage matrix crosswalking trial-balance captions to DISE natural-expense-categories per ASU 2023-07, and flags any income-statement caption with no mapped rows. Also computes an optional dollar coverage percentage when trial balance amounts are supplied. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

captions.description: Entity income statement captions, optionally with total balances

mappings.description: TB caption to DISE category mapping rows
